page_title: FUL 2-1 BRE | Fulham v Brentford 04/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+10' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Is that a yellow card in the referee's hand? It is! Harry Wilson (Fulham) gets booked.
90+7' Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham) picks up a yellow card.
90+7' 2 - 1 It's in! Harry Wilson (Fulham) finds space in the box and from close range powers an unstoppable header into the left of the goal after a cheeky lofted pass from Antonee Robinson. 2:1.
90+6' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Brentford comes to nothing.

90+6' Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition. The linesman points to the corner flag, Brentford are going to take it.

90+6' Fabio Carvalho (Brentford) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Bernd Leno shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90+3' Substitution. Vitaly Janelt makes his way off the pitch and Yegor Yarmolyuk (Brentford) comes on as his replacement.
90+2' 1 - 1 What a goal! Adama Traore swings a cross into the box and Harry Wilson (Fulham) scores a magnificent back-heel goal! 1:1.
90+1' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mark Flekken, who smothers the ball.
90' 6 additional min. will be played.
90' Tom Cairney (Fulham) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
90' Harry Wilson (Fulham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. Fulham force their opponents to concede a corner.
89' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) latches on to an accurate pass into the box and immediately unleashes a low shot goalwards. His effort is well saved by the keeper.
88' The game is interrupted. Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
88' The corner from Tom Cairney (Fulham) is intercepted by Mark Flekken.

87' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Fulham.
87' Adama Traore (Fulham) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ben Mee (Brentford) comes onto the pitch for Bryan Mbeumo.
85' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the corner, but his fine header towards the right post is brilliantly saved by the diving goalkeeper.
85' Tom Cairney (Fulham) will take a corner kick.
85' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear. Fulham will take a corner kick.

84' Timothy Castagne (Fulham) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Mark Flekken. This effort really didn't trouble him.
84' Tom Cairney (Fulham) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
83' An attempted cross from Harry Wilson (Fulham) is cleared. Fulham get a corner.
82' Marco Silva prepares a substitution. Emile Smith Rowe is replaced by Tom Cairney (Fulham).
82' That will be all from Reiss Nelson who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Harry Wilson (Fulham).
79' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
77' Adama Traore (Fulham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
76' Adama Traore (Fulham) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
76' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
73' Raul Jimenez comes off the pitch to be replaced by Rodrigo Muniz (Fulham).
73' That's the end of the game for Kenny Tete, who is replaced by Timothy Castagne (Fulham).
73' Substitution. Keane Lewis-Potter makes way for Fabio Carvalho (Brentford).
72' Thomas Frank has decided to make a change. Kevin Schade (Brentford) replaces Yoane Wissa.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mathias Jensen (Brentford) for Mikkel Damsgaard.
70' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) picks up a pass and unleashes a low shot towards goal, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Mark Flekken.
70' The resulting corner from Reiss Nelson (Fulham) comes to nothing.

69' Kenny Tete (Fulham) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.

68' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a strong shot towards the right side of the goal, but his effort is denied by the well positioned keeper with a stunning save.
67' Kenny Tete (Fulham) picks up a pass and tries his luck from mid-range towards the middle of the goal, but Mark Flekken is equal to it and makes an easy save.
67' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
66' Adama Traore (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but Mark Flekken comes off his line to gather the ball.
65' The substitution is prepared. Adama Traore (Fulham) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Andreas Pereira.
65' Mark Flekken comes off his line to intercept the corner from Andreas Pereira (Fulham).

64' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
63' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
59' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
58' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
57' Stuart Attwell shows a yellow card to Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
56' Mikkel Damsgaard (Brentford) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
56' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. Brentford have been awarded a corner kick.
55' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
53' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
52' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and Fulham manage to earn a corner.
49' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Alex Iwobi (Fulham), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post.
48' Yoane Wissa (Brentford) is penalised for a foul. Stuart Attwell had a clear view and blows his whistle.
47' Flag up against Alex Iwobi (Fulham). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
46' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Andreas Pereira (Fulham), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
46' Stuart Attwell interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Mads Roerslev Rasmussen (Brentford). A free kick is awarded to Fulham.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) is flagged for offside.
45+1' Brentford can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
45+1' Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Brentford.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
44' Mark Flekken pulls off a fantastic save! Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the right post, but the effort is kept out.
42' Bryan Mbeumo (Brentford) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Alex Iwobi (Fulham) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
39' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
37' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
36' A pass into the penalty area from Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is intercepted by the defence.
36' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
36' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety. Fulham have a corner.
33' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
29' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
28' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) gets to the ball from the resulting corner and tries his luck with a shot, but one of the defenders steps in to block the effort.
28' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
26' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Stuart Attwell blows his whistle for an infringement.
24' 0 - 1 Vitaly Janelt (Brentford) receives a quality pass, makes a yard for himself and smashes a jaw-dropping long-range shot inside the right post. What a remarkable goal!
24' Keane Lewis-Potter (Brentford) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Bernd Leno intercepts the ball.
21' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
19' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
17' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Mark Flekken has no trouble gathering it.
17' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) inside the box following a slide rule pass. Now Fulham have a corner.
15' Christian Norgaard (Brentford) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Stuart Attwell signals.
13' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
11' Mark Flekken (Brentford) is able to continue to play.
9' Mark Flekken (Brentford) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
6' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) collects a rebound and his promising attempt heads towards the bottom left corner, but Mark Flekken keeps it out with an amazing save.

6' Reiss Nelson (Fulham) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him.
3' Rough tackle by Vitaly Janelt (Brentford). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
2' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Mark Flekken gets down to his right to keep it out.
2' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
